changes.comment: Add an optional base64 content encoding to the storage wire format: StorageContentEncoding, IStorageFileResponse.encoding, IStorageReadFileRequest, and an encoding query parameter on GET /file. FsStorageProvider reads raw bytes and base64-encodes when asked. The default path is unchanged and omits the field, so existing responses stay byte-identical; an unrecognized encoding is a 400 rather than a silent downgrade.
